lines: On a one-two-three, we step over the goal line
We still don't know anything, anything at all
Cross the line, look back, and it's already gone
We still don't know anything, anything at all
We slog and slog and slog away
And the gleaming sweat spills over
There must have been plenty of things we can't remember
Everyone, everyone's a silhouette
The things I held dear — I pretended to forget them
There's nothing there — I can laugh about it
On a one-two-three, the boy remembers
We wanted everything, everything there was
I know it, ah, I'm well aware
The hands of the clock, the days, they never stop
It takes and takes and takes away
The flowing time and memory
Grow distant, distant, distant
There must have been plenty of things we can't remember
Everyone, everyone's a silhouette
The fear that never leaves me — I pretended not to know it
There's nothing there — I can laugh about it
Fluttering, fluttering, it dances
I want to live like a leaf, free of worry, free of haste
There were plenty of things we can't remember, but
That surely there's something that will never change
You, who taught me that, are a silhouette that won't fade, won't fade
I'll grow up holding on to what I want to cherish
Even then, I'll keep guarding it, never letting go
And then, someday
I'll be able to laugh at everything
Fluttering, fluttering, it dances
The leaf flies away
